title: 63rd CST performs search and rescue in wake of devastating Moore tornado
description: Sgt. Warren Williams from the 63rd Civil Support Team (CST) helps search and rescue efforts in Moore, Okla. Interview explaining the search techniques. Available in high definition.
keywords: tornado, Oklahoma National Guard, Moore, oklahoma tornado, 63rd CST

transcript.text: Warren Williams, W-A-R-R-E-N, Williams, the 63rd Civil Support Team.
Okay, a couple things actually. Victims, obviously.
Hazardous Materials, we're doing the atmospheric monitoring, make sure there's no gas leaks or any hydrogen salt fighter, anything like that.
It's kind of doing a couple things at once.
Well, live in Oklahoma, you kind of always got to expect something like this is going to happen.
You always hope it doesn't, but you got to be prepared for it.
Basically what we're doing is a kind of a combined search and rescue effort, along with monitoring for physical hazards such as hazmat and live power lines and stuff like that.
Basically, we are to market and report it.
If we mitigate it possible, if we can mitigate the hazard, that'd be the best thing so nobody else has to worry about it.
But if it's something like huge natural gas, we need to get other resources out.
Is this your first mission on the U.S. or is it?
We've been on several. As far as tornadoes, we're on the Piedmont Search and Rescue mission.
I think it's real satisfying the fact that we get to serve our community at home.
There's a lot of other agencies coming from other places, but for us, this is personal.
These are people we know, there's people in the unit that have been affected by this personally, so it's satisfying to be out here helping our fellow neighbors.
Well, we hope that we don't find anything. That'd be the best thing.
No hazards, no victims. Hopefully everybody's safe and sound, and this is just a precautionary measure.
This is your AGR for this and you have a civilian crew.

pass_reason: Interview about search technique after the Moore tornado; no rescue or outcome.
